brand.tagline: 把复杂信息，组织成清晰画面

monochrome.usage: symbol-black only; every painted pixel is RGB (0,0,0) with alpha carrying the shape

colours.rule: the three layer hues are the additive primaries; they never blend into a fourth colour inside the mark — overlap is expressed by position, not by mixing, which is the brand claim made visible

contrast_pairs.where: poster OPEN BETA (worst case scored against the panel it overlaps)

colours.contrast_method: check_a13.py computes WCAG relative-luminance ratios for every <Text> run and scores each against the tightest surface it can sit on (canvas background or the panel behind it), so no line is credited for a background it does not actually touch; results in check-report.json contrast

geometry.unit: S = side of the mark box; every length below is a fraction of S, so the same rule renders at 512, at 32 and inside a layout

A_translation.invariant: plate + 2*step == 1.0 (the three frames exactly fill the mark box on the diagonal)

B_rotation_rejected.rejection: preview tmp/.../A13/preview/alt-B-512.png reads as a prohibition sign at 32px and the 45-degree beam destroys the negative space the concept depends on

constructs.measured: check_a13.py mark_blocks() returns 4 shapes on all four delivered DSLs

clear_space.unit: fraction of the mark's own span S, measured to every edge of the canvas
clear_space.measured_symbol_color: margin 96px / ink span 320px = 0.300 (alpha bounding box of the delivered PNG)
clear_space.correction: banner v02 used a 56px edge margin and a 64px wordmark gap (0.255 S and 0.291 S). v04 moved both to round(0.30*S)=66px, which is what the checker now asserts for every application, not only for the symbol.

service_constraint.rule: borderRadius must be >= the border width, otherwise POST /snapshot returns HTTP 500 {"code":"INTERNAL_ERROR"} with no diagnostic
service_constraint.evidence: tmp/20261008T1615Z-run01/A13/probes/p01..p10 (.snapshot + .png + archived responses); 1.58<1.7, 1.0<1.7, 1.6<1.7, 1.9<2.0 fail, radius==stroke and radius>stroke return 200
service_constraint.handling: plan_a13.frame() clamps radius to max(radius, stroke) before emitting

small_size_rule.why: at 32px the 0.070 stroke renders as 2.2px and the two inner frames merge in the overlap; raising it to 0.085 (2.7px) keeps all four hues individually present — verified by check_a13.py on the native 32px service renders check-32-base.png / check-32-tuned.png
small_size_rule.measured_limitation: resampling the delivered 512 master down to 32 with LANCZOS loses the amber node (3.7px target). Recorded as a measurement, not a failure: icons must be rendered from the DSL at the target size, not scaled down. See check-report.json measurements.downscale_512_to_32_missing_hues.

symbol-color.derivation: icon(direction=A, variant=color) at S=320 inside the 512 box (clear space 0.30)

symbol-black.derivation: same icon() call with variant=black; check_a13.py compares the colour-stripped geometry attribute lists and they are identical, and all 49177 painted pixels are RGB (0,0,0)

brand-banner.type: 叠光 76pt BOLD + Layerlight 40pt tracked 1.5 + 3-segment layer rule + tagline 30pt, wordmark column starts at x=352
brand-banner.derivation: icon() re-emitted at S=220 plus a ghost layer set at 0.22/0.18/0.14 opacity bleeding off the right edge; mark blocks normalise to the symbol fingerprint

launch-poster.type: OPEN BETA 96pt tracked 6, night panel #151F33 radius 28 with 叠光 Layerlight 40 / tagline 28 / rule / date 34 / colour-chip row, url 28pt
launch-poster.derivation: independent vertical composition: 780px ghost frames at stroke 4 behind the mark, clipped to y<=660 by a ClipRect so the hairlines stop above the headline; panel block below the fold of the title; aspect 0.80 vs the banner's 3.00 and a disjoint colour set (#0B1220/#151F33/#F2F6FC/#8FA3C2/#2A3A55) prove it is not an enlarged banner

typography.line_box_rule: 1.45em per line (A12 measurement), reused for every text box here
typography.tracking: 96pt display line carries letterSpacing 6; body lines carry 0-2

forbidden_and_honoured: no ready-made logo, no text-as-icon: the mark is 4 geometric Containers, the wordmark is separate from it
no external images: check_a13.py asserts no <Image, no http(s), no base64 in any delivered DSL
no raster embedding of the icon into the banner/poster: the mark is re-derived from the same ratios (mark_rebuilt_from_symbol_geometry)
thumbnails at 32x32 live only in tmp/.../A13/preview/ and are never delivered as final art

covers: transparent canvases and RGB-zero black symbol
mark re-derived (not embedded) in banner and poster
poster is not an enlarged banner (aspect + disjoint palette)
four hues survive a native 32px service render
verification.probes: tmp/20261008T1615Z-run01/A13/probes/ p01..p10 — the borderRadius vs border-width boundary that produces HTTP 500
